name: Assessment case

title: "assessment(scope): "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Proposition and assessment context

State the exact assertion being evaluated, affected subject and consuming boundary.

## Source authority and provenance

Provide original repository, exact revision/tag, associated consolidated finding ID and source links. Say whether the evidence is source text, tests, deployed execution or reviewer judgment.

## Existing owner / deduplication

Link the existing registry case or explain why no current case covers this proposition. Identify the RAHP issue, upstream remediation issue or specialist owner where applicable.

## Falsification and required evidence

Describe at least one meaningful failure or false-success condition, with source and runtime evidence still missing.

## Proposed disposition

Distinguish administrative lifecycle, source-level classification and RAHP determination. Unknown/indeterminate is acceptable.

## Reassessment trigger

State the specific material change or evidence artifact that would justify another review.
